name: Creates a topic.
description: Creates a topic. Creates a topic. POST /v1/courses/{courseId}/topics
context:
POST /v1/courses/{courseId}/topics
Creates a topic. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to access the requested course, create a topic in the requested course, or for access errors. * `INVALID_ARGUMENT` if the request is malformed. * `ALREADY_EXISTS` if there exists a topic in the course with the same name. * `FAILED_PRECONDITION` for the following request error: * CourseTopicLimitReached * `NOT_FOUND` if the requested course does not exist.
Required: courseId (path) — Identifier of the course. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.; body (body)
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Deletes a topic.
description: Deletes a topic. Deletes a topic. DELETE /v1/courses/{courseId}/topics/{id}
context:
DELETE /v1/courses/{courseId}/topics/{id}
Deletes a topic. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not allowed to delete the requested topic or for access errors. * `FAILED_PRECONDITION` if the requested topic has already been deleted. * `NOT_FOUND` if no course or topic exists with the requested ID.
Required: id (path) — Identifier of the topic to delete.; courseId (path) — Identifier of the course. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

GET /v1/courses/{courseId}/topics
Returns the list of topics that the requester is permitted to view. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to access the requested course or for access errors. * `INVALID_ARGUMENT` if the request is malformed. * `NOT_FOUND` if the requested course does not exist.

Optional: pageToken (query) — nextPageToken value returned from a previous list call, indicating that the subsequent page of results should be returned. The list request must be otherwise identical to the one that resulted in this token.; pageSize (query) — Maximum number of items to return. Zero or unspecified indicates that the server may assign a maximum. The server may return fewer than the specified number of results.; fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Updates one or more fields of a topic.
description: Updates one or more fields of a topic. Updates one or more fields of a topic. PATCH /v1/courses/{courseId}/topics/{id}
context:
PATCH /v1/courses/{courseId}/topics/{id}
Updates one or more fields of a topic. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting developer project did not create the corresponding topic or for access errors. * `INVALID_ARGUMENT` if the request is malformed. * `FAILED_PRECONDITION` if there exists a topic in the course with the same name. * `NOT_FOUND` if the requested course or topic does not exist
Required: id (path) — Identifier of the topic.; courseId (path) — Identifier of the course. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.; body (body)
Optional: updateMask (query) — Mask that identifies which fields on the topic to update. This field is required to do an update. The update fails if invalid fields are specified. If a field supports empty values, it can be cleared by specifying it in the update mask and not in the Topic object. If a field that does not support empty values is included in the update mask and not set in the Topic object, an `INVALID_ARGUMENT` error is returned. The following fields may be specified: * `name`; fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.
